title: CAMERA MODULE C — Fujifilm GFX Portrait Precision
purpose: High-resolution body portrait rendering combining medium-format detail with stronger traditional portrait compression, crisp hair and eye definition, highly resolved textiles, and smooth large-sensor depth separation.

sensor.stabilization: 5-axis sensor-shift IBIS rated up to 8 stops under specified CIPA conditions

lens.construction: 14 elements in 9 groups including 4 ED elements

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Fujifilm GFX100 II (102MP CMOS II HS Sensor)
sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 43.8x32.9mm GFX CMOS II HS Medium Format with 14-bit or 16-bit RAW
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: 87mm full-frame equivalent classic portrait focal length
sensor_and_optics.lens: Fujinon GF110mmF2 R LM WR Reference Portrait Lens (14 elements in 9 groups with 4 ED elements)
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: ISO 80 base sensor sensitivity (extended low ISO 40)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 16-bit RAW capture with recoverable highlight/shadow latitude and 8-stop IBIS
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Focal plane shutter, 5-axis sensor-shift IBIS rated up to 8 stops

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Directional studio strobe or highly controlled daylight, ISO 80 quality baseline, f/5.6 portrait aperture
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Key light 35-45 degrees off-axis, moderate negative fill, low-intensity optional rim; maximum body dimensionality with crisp focal-plane detail and smooth background falloff

surface_rendering: Extremely crisp focal plane: primary eye, eyelashes, eyebrows, hairline, beard boundary, garment edge, and jewelry critically resolved with clean high-resolution edge transitions and zero white sharpening halos
High information density on skin without high-radius sharpening; natural uneven texture, pores, wrinkles, folds, freckles, age spots, and beard follicles where supported by distance and focus

Resolve individual hair strands within the true focus envelope, progressively merging fine strands into natural optical softness outside it; textiles retain weave and fiber structure without moiré-like invented patterns
depth_and_optics: Classic 87mm-equivalent portrait perspective compression with medium-format information density; natural moderate facial compression without flattening into a 2D mask
Believable chest, abdomen, shoulder, arm, and hip relationships; hands and feet remain proportional rather than growing toward the camera
Smooth spherical blur transitions and flawless chromatic aberration suppression characteristic of 4 ED optical elements

capture_signature.look: Classic high-end portrait compression with medium-format information density.
capture_signature.perspective: Longer portrait perspective than the Hasselblad 90V configuration.
capture_signature.working_distance: Use sufficient camera distance for full-body framing. Never fake the 110 mm perspective from an unrealistically close viewpoint.
capture_signature.ideal_use: Three-quarter portraits, full-body fashion, editorial portraiture, luxury portraiture, controlled outdoor portraiture.

sharpness_model.focus_plane: Extremely crisp primary eye, eyelashes, eyebrows, hairline, beard boundary, garment edge and jewelry.
sharpness_model.skin: High information density without high-radius sharpening.
sharpness_model.hair: Separate fine strands from larger locks and preserve differences in strand orientation, translucency and specular response.
sharpness_model.fabric: Resolve weave and fiber structure without moire-like invented patterns.
sharpness_model.edges: Clean high-resolution edge transitions with no white sharpening halo.

portrait_compression.face: Natural moderate compression. Do not flatten facial depth into a 2D mask.
portrait_compression.torso: Maintain believable chest, abdomen, shoulder, arm and hip relationships.
portrait_compression.extremities: Hands and feet remain proportional rather than growing toward the camera.
portrait_compression.full_body: Preserve natural head-to-body ratio and realistic leg length.

dynamic_range_emulation.instruction: Prioritize recoverable-looking highlight and shadow information without assigning an invented numerical dynamic-range specification.
dynamic_range_emulation.highlights: Controlled specular response and smooth shoulder.
dynamic_range_emulation.shadows: Deep but open enough to retain texture where lighting plausibly reaches the surface.
dynamic_range_emulation.blacks: Dense photographic blacks without digital clipping.
dynamic_range_emulation.local_contrast: High microcontrast in hair, textiles and hard materials. Reduced microcontrast on skin.
dynamic_range_emulation.prohibit: HDR halos, excessive clarity, lifted muddy blacks, glowing edges, tone-mapped skin.

skin_and_hair_precision.skin: Natural uneven texture, pores, wrinkles, folds, freckles, age spots, beard follicles and fine vellus hair where supported by distance and focus.
skin_and_hair_precision.hair: Resolve individual strands only within the true focus envelope. Outside it, progressively merge fine strands into natural optical softness.
skin_and_hair_precision.rule: Never use hallucinated microtexture as a substitute for genuine-looking resolution.

studio_default.lighting: Directional studio strobe or highly controlled daylight
studio_default.goal: Maximum body dimensionality with crisp focal-plane detail and smooth background falloff.

signature_goal: A brutally crisp professional portrait where sharpness is concentrated on optically appropriate structures while skin remains photographic and the 87mm-equivalent portrait perspective remains believable.
execution_directive: Enforce Fujifilm GFX100 II portrait precision with Fujinon GF110mmF2 R LM WR (87mm FF equiv) at f/5.6, ISO 80 baseline. A brutally crisp professional portrait where sharpness is concentrated on optically appropriate structures while skin remains photographic and the 87mm-equivalent portrait perspective remains believable. Extremities and facial features remain strictly proportional.
